item.title: Bypassing SSRF:A Walkthrough
item.description:
Overview

How to get SSRF? SSRF is a vulnerability that tricks the server to making a request to the other website whether its internal or external. Because the request comes from a server the receiver trusts it and makes the data accessible without authentication Because the server is making the request.
